text.en: Customer perceptions of kennel staff are sharply polarised. Many regular patrons praise Kerina, Emmet, and the team for being welcoming, warm, and attentive to their visiting dogs. However, severe critical reviews allege ties to past management and previous kennel controversies, urging pet owners to exercise caution when booking.

Positive reviewers report that their dogs return home tired and happy after socialising in the play yard during boarding or daycare. In contrast, serious negative feedback raises alarm over historical safety incidents and rebrandings. While daily boarding clients report no problems, these critical warnings create stark divisions in owner sentiment.

Several boarding clients appreciate receiving video clips and messages showing their pets playing comfortably during their stay. They describe regular communication as straightforward and reassuring. Conversely, critical reviewers claim management reacts defensively to public scrutiny, resulting in mixed perceptions of customer relations.

q.en: Does the facility provide outdoor play areas?

a.en: Yes, the kennel grounds include an outdoor yard where social dogs can exercise together during their stay.

q.en: Do staff send video updates during boarding?

a.en: Reviewers note that kennel staff often send video clips and photo updates showing dogs active in the play areas.

q.en: Why do some reviews express strong concern?

a.en: Several online reviews cite historical controversies under former facility names, leading to polarized customer opinions.

q.en: What are the standard drop-off and collection hours?

a.en: Opening hours run in morning and late afternoon sessions from Monday through Saturday, remaining closed on Sundays.
